name: lineage-bridge
description: End-to-end column lineage from a dbt source to the Power BI visual that renders it.

scripts.build:viewer: npm --prefix ui install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ui run build && node scripts/stage-viewer.mjs
scripts.build:web: node scripts/pack-python.mjs && npm run build:viewer && npm --prefix ui run build -- --mode web
